title: Refer to patterns by their number
description: Say 'apply pattern 12', not a copy of the text.
root_cause: Copied text goes stale and drifts. The number always points to the current version.
diagnosis_steps: In instructions, skills and handoffs write the pattern number and let the agent fetch it.
quick_fix: GET /api/v1/memory/<id> to read the current text.
root_fix: Instructions stay short, and updating one pattern updates every place that refers to it.
